description: Create, update or destroy an aaa group object in Sophos UTM.

parameters.name: adirectory_groups
parameters.description: List of adirectory group strings. Default: []

parameters.name: adirectory_groups_sids
parameters.description: Dictionary of group sids. Default: {}

parameters.name: backend_match
parameters.description: The backend for the group. Choices: "none" ← (default) "adirectory" "edirectory" "radius" "tacacs" "ldap"

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: Comment that describes the AAA group. Default: ""

parameters.name: dynamic
parameters.description: Group type. Is static if none is selected. Choices: "none" ← (default) "ipsec_dn" "directory_groups"

parameters.name: edirectory_groups
parameters.description: List of edirectory group strings. Default: []

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: A dictionary of additional headers to be sent to POST and PUT requests. Is needed for some modules. Default: {}

parameters.name: ipsec_dn
parameters.description: The ipsec dn string. Default: ""

parameters.name: ldap_attribute
parameters.description: The ldap attribute to check against. Default: ""

parameters.name: ldap_attribute_value
parameters.description: The ldap attribute value to check against. Default: ""

parameters.name: members
parameters.description: A list of user ref names (aaa/user). Default: []

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the object that identifies the entry.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: The network reference name. The objects contains the known IP addresses for the authentication object (network/aaa). Default: ""

parameters.name: radius_groups
parameters.description: A list of radius group strings. Default: []

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The desired state of the object. present creates or updates an object. absent deletes an object if present. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: tacacs_groups
parameters.description: A list of tacacs group strings. Default: []

parameters.name: utm_host
parameters.description: The REST Endpoint of the Sophos UTM.

parameters.name: utm_port
parameters.description: The port of the REST interface. Default: 4444

parameters.name: utm_protocol
parameters.description: The protocol of the REST Endpoint. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: utm_token
parameters.description: The token used to identify at the REST-API. See https://www.sophos.com/en-us/medialibrary/PDFs/documentation/UTMonAWS/Sophos-UTM-RESTful-API.pdf?la=en, Chapter 2.4.2.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether the REST interface’s SSL certificate should be verified or not. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create UTM aaa_group
  community.general.utm_aaa_group:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestAAAGroupEntry
    backend_match: ldap
    dynamic: directory_groups
    ldap_attributes: memberof
    ldap_attributes_value: "cn=groupname,ou=Groups,dc=mydomain,dc=com"
    network: REF_OBJECT_STRING
    state: present

- name: Remove UTM aaa_group
  community.general.utm_aaa_group:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestAAAGroupEntry
    state: absent

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: The utm object that was created. Returned: success

return_values.name: _locked
return_values.description: Whether or not the object is currently locked. Returned: success

return_values.name: _ref
return_values.description: The reference name of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: _type
return_values.description: The type of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: adirectory_groups
return_values.description: List of Active Directory Groups. Returned: success

return_values.name: adirectory_groups_sids
return_values.description: List of Active Directory Groups SIDS. Returned: success

return_values.name: backend_match
return_values.description: The backend to use. Returned: success

return_values.name: dynamic
return_values.description: Whether the group match is ipsec_dn or directory_group. Returned: success

return_values.name: edirectory_groups
return_values.description: List of eDirectory Groups. Returned: success

return_values.name: ipsec_dn
return_values.description: Ipsec_dn identifier to match. Returned: success

return_values.name: ldap_attribute
return_values.description: The LDAP Attribute to match against. Returned: success

return_values.name: ldap_attribute_value
return_values.description: The LDAP Attribute Value to match against. Returned: success

return_values.name: members
return_values.description: List of member identifiers of the group. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: network
return_values.description: The identifier of the network (network/aaa). Returned: success

return_values.name: radius_group
return_values.description: The radius group identifier. Returned: success

return_values.name: tacacs_group
return_values.description: The tacacs group identifier. Returned: success
